title: Thermostat schedule editor
summary: Replaced the Schedule page's dense 48-button day editor with a compact thermostat-style 24-hour rail and tuned the editor sizing so all seven days render without the editor table's vertical scroll cap.
reason: The previous editor carried large negative space and forced operators to scan many labeled half-hour buttons. A rail communicates daily allowed time windows more directly without changing backend schedule policy.
behavior_before: Each schedule day rendered a multi-row grid of visible half-hour text buttons plus separate current schedule text.
behavior_after: Each schedule day renders a single dynamically sized 24-hour rail with 48 snap cells, 3-hour tick labels, compact staged/saved window text, and the existing clear/all/copy/paste day actions; the editor table exposes all seven days without an inner vertical scroller.
